name: Tower of Babel
description: The squad reaches the alien command spire. Oracle Echo makes contact, revealing the alien chain of command. Xal'Thun awaits at the apex.

objectives.description: Ascend the tower through the lower decks

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: The tower's energy signature is unlike anything I've scanned. It's almost... alive.

dialogue.speaker: Spectre
dialogue.line: Lower decks clear. Moving to security grid.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Echo
dialogue.line: You have disabled my guards. Interesting. The ring's protocols are... flexible.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Echo
dialogue.line: The aliens call this spire 'Babel'. They built it to speak to the ring's core. It is also their weakness.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Shade
dialogue.line: You climb higher. The protocols grow harsher. I've already adjusted the spawn rates. You're welcome.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Xal'Thun is defeated. But the ring's seal is broken. You must reach the foundation before the cycle completes.
